q: Find the odd one out: Car, Bus, Rickshaw, Scooter
exp: Auto is the odd one out

q: A batsman hits 4 boundary balls in a row. What is the total number of runs he scored?
In a class of 40 students, 3/5 of the students are boys. How many girls are there?
A bat weighs 1.5 kg. What is the weight of 8 such bats?
Find the next number in the series: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, ?
exp: Series is double the previous number

q: A snail is at the bottom of a 20-foot well. Each day, it climbs 4 feet and slips back 2 feet. How many days will it take to climb out of the well?
A boy has 15 red balls, 20 blue balls, and 25 green balls. How many balls does he have in total?
A man is 40 years old. He will be twice as old as his son in 10 years. How old is his son now?
exp: Let son's age be x, then 40 + 10 = 2(x + 10)

q: A car travels 240 km in 4 hours. How much distance will it travel in 6 hours at the same speed?
A water tank has 5 taps. Each tap can fill 10 buckets per hour. How many buckets can 3 such taps fill in 4 hours?
exp: 3 taps can fill 30 buckets per hour, 30 * 4 = 120

q: A car travels 400 km in 5 hours. How much distance will it travel in 8 hours at the same speed?
A boy has 15 marbles in a bag. He draws 5 marbles from the bag. How many marbles are left in the bag?
A man has 2 sons and 1 daughter. The product of the age of the sons is 70. What is the age of the daughter?
exp: Let age of one son be x, then x * (x + 5) = 70, x = 5, daughter's age = 7
